body: Rig facts recorded as name lists in an optional per-pack `rig: Some((models, skinned_meshes, joints, clips))`; counts are list lengths. Rejected: numeric count fields (Python RON parser has no numbers) and a top-level `rigs` section (splits facts from their pack).

GLB-vs-manifest verification lives in tools/fetch_assets.py (extract + --check), not in a Rust test: bytes are SHA-pinned, and a Rust check would need a new serde_json dev-dependency. Rust validates schema/consistency only.

AnimState has 6 variants (Idle, Walk, Run, Sprint, Jump, Fall), one per acceptance case; the archive has no run clip, so visual.ron maps Run to a clip (default sprint at rate ~0.63). Rejected: 5 variants with run folded into Sprint (table case 'бежит' would not be distinguishable).

Clip handles resolved synchronously by glTF animation index taken from the manifest rig clip order (verified against the GLB by fetch_assets.py). Rejected: waiting on Handle<Gltf>.named_animations (extra async load step and an observer-ordering race).

Clothing-only tint via texture: body-mesh UVs also hit skin texels (hands/neck) of the shared colormap, so a multiplicative tint on body-mesh also tints hands; no clean clothing mask without a custom palette. Plan uses body-mesh base_color multiply and leaves the look to the owner.

Headless client gate that triggers WorldInstanceReady by hand is not possible: InstanceId::new is private in bevy_world_serialization 0.19.1 (world_asset_spawner.rs:52-58), and WorldInstanceReady is not in bevy::prelude. on_model_ready wiring is gated by runtime QA over BRP; the headless client gate covers the spawn observer, the graph and drive_character_animation.

CharacterAnimations is built with FromWorld + init_resource in CharacterVisualsPlugin::build (precedent: CharacterControlConfig), not in a Startup system; the alternative Startup + Res in the observer depended on Startup-before-OnEnter(Playing) ordering and could panic.

AnimState airborne = Tnua is_airborne() OR Jump action running, instead of is_airborne() alone (plan step 6). Rejected alternative: is_airborne() only - walk basis keeps the ground sensor (float_height+cling_distance=2.05 m) hit during any hop < ~1 m, so a Space tap never showed Jump/Fall (t4.py run1, probe). Alternative not taken: threshold on sensor proximity (new tuning number).

t4.py screenshot cadence: record gaps > 2x200 ms as cadence_misses in summary.json and stdout, not a scenario failure; alternative (hard interval tolerance assert, review item 2) rejected because screenshots are owner evidence, AnimState is gated by 50 ms samples, and the recorded passing run already has a 282 ms gap from BRP latency.

Counter-example "short Space tap while running shows Run mid-air" rejected for taps of 3+ fixed ticks (20 gait x hold combinations through headless_app); a 1-tick press still bobs the body 0.185 m with AnimState back to Idle/Run after one tick (Low, T1 jump quirk).
